objective: Implement a deterministic one-click runner recovery and real GitHub round-trip smoke test in the F portable control panel. The Tek Runner Baslat action must perform all safety, git, PID, lock, heartbeat, artifact, push, and remote-readback checks without starting a second runner.
implementation_requirements: Wire the existing Tek Runner Baslat button to one deterministic recovery controller.
Verify portable root, repo root, remote repository, branch, git status, merge/rebase state, lock file, live PID, heartbeat PID, panel PID, and heartbeat age.
Never start a second runner when the lock PID is alive.
Only remove a stale lock after proving its PID is dead.
Safely stash dirty worktree changes and preserve the stash until pull/sync succeeds.
Reconcile panel PID, lock PID, and heartbeat PID before reporting runner active.
Require heartbeat age <= 60 seconds for PASS.
Run an immediate priority smoke control task inside the same single runner, without creating a parallel runner.
Have the real runner write the required smoke artifact with a unique run_id and generated_by_real_runner=true.
Commit and push the smoke artifact to the target branch.
Fetch the remote branch and read the exact artifact back from origin to prove GitHub round-trip success.
Write a push proof containing artifact commit SHA, push result, remote readback result, run_id, and artifact path.
Expose PASS/FAIL for each stage in the portable control panel, including artifact path and commit SHA.
Write an explicit blocker output on any failure and do not claim PASS, completed, or 100 percent.
Keep final_ready=false and all safety flags unchanged.
acceptance_checks: one click starts the full recovery and smoke-test sequence
repeated clicks do not start a second runner
panel PID equals lock PID equals heartbeat PID
heartbeat is fresh and from the canonical F portable runner
git pull/sync succeeds or a specific blocker is produced
required smoke artifact exists on the target GitHub branch
required smoke artifact was generated by the real runner
smoke artifact contains a unique run_id and AAYS_ONE_CLICK_RUNNER_SMOKE_OK payload
remote readback returns the same run_id and payload
push proof contains the first artifact commit SHA
ChatGPT can fetch the stable artifact path from GitHub
processed smoke task has an explicit completed status only after the remote readback succeeds
db_write, migration, and production_deploy remain false
